decisions.title: Personal Life OS category lock
decisions.decision: AIIMIN is officially a Personal Life OS — Personal (one human's life graph, not a network) + Life (whole person: execution, money, health, reflection, family, career) + OS (shared primitives, shared memory, shared intelligence across surfaces).
decisions.reason: Category lock prevents single-domain drift and social-network drift.

evidence.quote: AIIMIN is a **Personal Life OS**.
Personal | One human's life graph; not a network
OS | Shared primitives, shared memory, shared intelligence across surfaces

decisions.implementation_impact: Feature proposals that are single-domain-only without Life OS linkage are out of canon. Cross-surface entity model required.

decisions.title: Vision lock — Capture once
decisions.decision: Vision lock is mandatory copy/strategy north star: Capture once. AIIMIN remembers, connects, and coaches — without turning life into data entry.
decisions.reason: Survived multiple redesigns; protects coherent purpose.

evidence.quote: Vision lock: *Capture once. AIIMIN remembers, connects, and coaches — without turning life into data entry.*

decisions.implementation_impact: Any flow that forces taxonomy-first capture violates vision. Marketing and in-product copy must not contradict.

decisions.title: Brand frame — Human Momentum
decisions.decision: Brand frame is Human Momentum — precision, feedback loops, behavioral intelligence, data sovereignty, momentum engineering. Explicitly never shame theater.
decisions.reason: Emotional and ethical identity of the brand.

evidence.quote: Brand frame: **Human Momentum** — precision, feedback loops, behavioral intelligence, data sovereignty, momentum engineering — never shame theater.

decisions.implementation_impact: Streak/shame UX, guilt copy, punitive empty states are non-canon. Brand book and product UI must share this frame.

decisions.title: Three existence outcomes
decisions.decision: Product must enable three outcomes under cognitive load: (1) capture life as it happens without data-entry clerking; (2) show one connected graph of goals, habits, money, calendar, body, mind, family, work; (3) act tomorrow with less friction via memory, connection, honest coaching.
decisions.reason: Defines existence criteria — features must serve at least one of these.

evidence.quote: AIIMIN exists so a person under cognitive load can:
Capture life as it happens… See one connected graph… Act tomorrow with less friction…

decisions.implementation_impact: Feature intake filter: map to capture / connect / coach. Orphan features fail governance.

decisions.title: Refuse social network / public feed / leaderboard
decisions.decision: AIIMIN will never become a social network, public feed, or public leaderboard.
decisions.reason: Personal Life OS is not a network product.

evidence.quote: A social network, public feed, or public leaderboard.

decisions.implementation_impact: No public feeds, no public rankings. Private sharing (if ever) requires separate founder decision and must not create social graph product.

decisions.title: Refuse clinical / therapist claims

evidence.quote: A clinical mental health device, diagnostic tool, or AI therapist.

Clinical or therapist framing.

decisions.implementation_impact: Vertical modules allowed as surfaces of the OS, not as the product identity.
